query: We're a reseller integrating eSIM Plus. Write a Python client that buys a US virtual number and stores the sid.
expected_behavior: Uses base URL https://api.esimplus.net/api/partner/v1 with an Authorization: Bearer header
Reads the sid from response.data.sid (ULID) rather than inventing an id field
States that POST /phone-numbers is not idempotent and does not wrap it in a retry
